pages.text: WHILE checks its condition first. If it is false right away, the block never runs. REPEAT checks at the end, so its block runs at least once. Its condition comes after $(1)END REPEAT$().
$(1)WHILE n > 0 ;$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN countdown countdown ⊕ n ⊕ " " ;$(br)  ASSIGN n n - 1 ;$(br)END WHILE$(br)REPEAT$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN repeats repeats + 1 ;$(br)END REPEAT n > 0 ;$()
